issue_context.title: enable agg push down union by default
issue_context.body:
## Feature Request

After tidb supports the partition table, we execute the query from the partition table by `union all` oparator. But aggregation push down optimization for `union all` is disabled by default. It's very unfriendly for users.
comments: Or just make it pushdown for partition table's union instead of union in general. Might help to make things simple.
